preconditions.description: The number of routers n must be between 2 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p[i] < i + 2 for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The list p must contain n-1 integers where each p_i is between 1 and i.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of the path from the 1st to the n-th router.
The path must start with 1 and end with n.
All elements in the path must be distinct.
